title: Acropra DNA extraction with Qiagen DNAease tissue kit
author: Iliana Baums
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcwuixew
materials: Acroporid tissue Qiagen DNeasy Blood and Tissue extraction protocol with modifications
Follow Qiagen’s protocol with the following changes:
This elution typically contains smaller fragmented DNA.

steps.title: Use sterile technique to cut 3-4...
steps.instruction: Use sterile technique to cut 3-4 polyps (skeleton with tissue) off the coral fragment with a razor blade.

steps.title: Transfer the pieces to a 1
steps.instruction: Transfer the pieces to a 1.5 ml tube/96-well plate.

steps.title: Add 180 ul of Buffer ATL...
steps.instruction: Add 180 ul of Buffer ATL and 20 ul of proteinase K (from Qiagen kit) to each tube/well.

steps.title: If using the tubes, invert the...
steps.instruction: If using the tubes, invert the tubes several times to gently mix the reagents. *Do not vortex*

steps.title: The mixture will have a slight...
steps.instruction: The mixture will have a slight yellow hue after lysis from the algal symbionts.

steps.title: The tubes or plate can be...
steps.instruction: The tubes or plate can be placed on a rocking platform for gentle agitation.

steps.title: Pick up at step 3 of...
steps.instruction: Pick up at step 3 of the spin-column protocol or step 5 of the plate protocol.

steps.title: Following step 6 of the spin-column...
steps.instruction: Following step 6 of the spin-column protocol, we perform the optional centrifugation for 1 min at 20,000 xg to dry the column membrane.

steps.title: Elution 1- Add 100 ul of...
steps.instruction: Elution 1- Add 100 ul of low TE buffer directly to the column membrane, incubate for 1 min and centrifuge as recommended.

steps.title: Elution 2 – Move the column to a new 1
steps.instruction: Elution 2 – Move the column to a new 1.5 ml tube. Repeat elution as above, but increase incubation of 100 ul of low TE to 5 min.

steps.title: This elution contains high molecular weight...
steps.instruction: This elution contains high molecular weight DNA and is used for downstream analyses.
